import MumfordLib.GroupCohomologyAlternation
import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Projective
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.MinimalAxioms

/-!
# Injectivity of lattice group-cohomology alternation

A symmetric integral two-cocycle on a free abelian group is a coboundary:
its twisted extension is abelian, and projectivity splits the projection onto
the free group. This proves injectivity of alternation on actual group H2,
without a comparison with singular cohomology or a bilinearity assumption on
the cocycle.

This is an algebraic proof of the injectivity assertion in Mumford,
*Abelian Varieties*, Chapter I, pp. 16-17.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {U : Type} [AddCommGroup U]

private structure CocycleExtension (U : Type) where
  coeff : ℤ
  period : U

omit [AddCommGroup U] in
private theorem cocycleExtension_ext {x y : CocycleExtension U}
    (h₁ : x.coeff = y.coeff) (h₂ : x.period = y.period) : x = y := by
  cases x
  cases y
  simp_all

private abbrev cocycleExtensionAddCommGroup
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (hF : ∀ u v : U, F (Multiplicative.ofAdd u, Multiplicative.ofAdd v) =
      F (Multiplicative.ofAdd v, Multiplicative.ofAdd u)) :
    AddCommGroup (CocycleExtension U) := by
  letI : Add (CocycleExtension U) := ⟨fun x y => ⟨x.coeff + y.coeff -
    F (Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period, Multiplicative.ofAdd y.period),
    x.period + y.period⟩⟩
  letI : Zero (CocycleExtension U) := ⟨⟨F (1, 1), 0⟩⟩
  letI : Neg (CocycleExtension U) := ⟨fun x => ⟨-x.coeff +
    F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (-x.period), Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period) + F (1, 1),
    -x.period⟩⟩
  have hassoc (x y z : CocycleExtension U) : (x + y) + z = x + (y + z) := by
    apply cocycleExtension_ext
    · have h := (groupCohomology.mem_cocycles₂_iff F).mp F.property
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period) (Multiplicative.ofAdd y.period)
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd z.period)
      simp only [Representation.isTrivial_apply, ← ofAdd_add] at h
      change (x.coeff + y.coeff -
        F (Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period, Multiplicative.ofAdd y.period)) + z.coeff -
        F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (x.period + y.period), Multiplicative.ofAdd z.period) =
        x.coeff + (y.coeff + z.coeff -
          F (Multiplicative.ofAdd y.period, Multiplicative.ofAdd z.period)) -
          F (Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period, Multiplicative.ofAdd (y.period + z.period))
      omega
    · exact add_assoc _ _ _
  have hzero (x : CocycleExtension U) : 0 + x = x := by
    apply cocycleExtension_ext
    · have h := groupCohomology.cocycles₂_map_one_fst F
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period)
      change F (1, 1) + x.coeff - F (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period) = x.coeff
      rw [h]
      exact add_sub_cancel_left _ _
    · exact zero_add _
  have hneg (x : CocycleExtension U) : -x + x = 0 := by
    apply cocycleExtension_ext
    · change (-x.coeff +
        F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (-x.period), Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period) + F (1, 1)) +
        x.coeff - F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (-x.period), Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period) =
        F (1, 1)
      omega
    · exact neg_add_cancel _
  letI := AddGroup.ofLeftAxioms hassoc hzero hneg
  refine { add_comm := ?_ }
  intro x y
  apply cocycleExtension_ext
  · change x.coeff + y.coeff -
      F (Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period, Multiplicative.ofAdd y.period) =
      y.coeff + x.coeff - F (Multiplicative.ofAdd y.period, Multiplicative.ofAdd x.period)
    rw [hF x.period y.period, add_comm x.coeff y.coeff]
  · exact add_comm _ _

/-- Every symmetric integral two-cocycle on a free abelian group is a coboundary.
The cocycle need not be normalized or bilinear. -/
theorem groupTwoCocycle_mem_coboundaries_of_symmetric [Module.Free ℤ U]
    (F : groupCohomology.cocycles₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ))
    (hF : ∀ u v : U, F (Multiplicative.ofAdd u, Multiplicative.ofAdd v) =
      F (Multiplicative.ofAdd v, Multiplicative.ofAdd u)) :
    (F : Multiplicative U × Multiplicative U → ℤ) ∈
      groupCohomology.coboundaries₂ (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ) := by
  letI := cocycleExtensionAddCommGroup F hF
  let p : CocycleExtension U →+ U :=
    { toFun := CocycleExtension.period
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property p.toIntLinearMap
    (LinearMap.id : U →ₗ[ℤ] U) (fun u => ⟨⟨0, u⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hs_period (u : U) : (s u).period = u :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hs u
  refine ⟨fun u => (s u.toAdd).coeff, ?_⟩
  funext uv
  obtain ⟨u, v⟩ := uv
  have h := congrArg CocycleExtension.coeff (s.map_add u.toAdd v.toAdd)
  change (s (u.toAdd + v.toAdd)).coeff =
    (s u.toAdd).coeff + (s v.toAdd).coeff -
      F (Multiplicative.ofAdd (s u.toAdd).period,
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (s v.toAdd).period) at h
  rw [hs_period, hs_period] at h
  change (s (u.toAdd + v.toAdd)).coeff =
    (s u.toAdd).coeff + (s v.toAdd).coeff - F (u, v) at h
  simp only [groupCohomology.d₁₂_hom_apply, Representation.isTrivial_apply]
  change (s v.toAdd).coeff - (s (u.toAdd + v.toAdd)).coeff +
    (s u.toAdd).coeff = F (u, v)
  omega

/-- Alternation detects zero in integral group H2 of a free abelian group. -/
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_eq_zero_iff [Module.Free ℤ U]
    (x : groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial ℤ (Multiplicative U) ℤ)) :
    groupSecondCohomologyAlternation x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => h ▸ map_zero _⟩
  refine groupCohomology.H2_induction_on x fun F hF => ?_
  apply (groupCohomology.H2π_eq_zero_iff F).mpr
  apply groupTwoCocycle_mem_coboundaries_of_symmetric F
  intro u v
  rw [groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_π] at hF
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hF ![u, v]
  change F (Multiplicative.ofAdd u, Multiplicative.ofAdd v) -
    F (Multiplicative.ofAdd v, Multiplicative.ofAdd u) = 0 at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

/-- The alternation map is injective for every free abelian group. -/
theorem groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_injective [Module.Free ℤ U] :
    Function.Injective (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation (U := U)) := by
  intro x y h
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (groupSecondCohomologyAlternation_eq_zero_iff (x - y)).mp
  rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]

end Mumford.Analytic
